race.comment: JUST INCREDIBLE (3) comes here after making a move a long way from home and getting up to score by 1.1 metres at his latest appearance over 2190m at this track. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Steps up a level but he is up to the task. UNITED (9) finished fourth last start over 2190m here, beaten 9 metres, after a good win at this circuit the run prior. Certainly cannot be faulted after that last effort and is good enough to put himself back in the winners' stall. KYORETSU (1) is on the radar after his last-start fourth over 2190m at this venue two weeks ago. Include from the coveted pegs draw. THE GOLDEN HOOK (8) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at Shepparton over 2190m. Can trouble the judge with any luck in running.
